newsitem.title: USA: Star Resources makes acquisition, votes split.
newsitem.headline: Star Resources makes acquisition, votes split.

text.p: Star Resources Inc said Tuesday it acquired ICA B.V., a Dutch limited liability company and wholly owned subsidiary of ICA Marketing Co L.C., in exchange for four million shares of common stock.
In connection with the transaction, the company changed its name to Logiphone Group Inc and brought about an 82.85-for-one reverse stock split.
Following this split and the acquisition, ICA Marketing, an Iowa limited liability company, owns about 89 percent of Logiphone Group's outstanding common.

All directors and officers of Star Resources prior to the transaction resigned except for Michael Herschman, who has remained as a director. Marc Schechtman was elected chief executive officer and chairman, and Ron Gardner was elected president and director.
Logiphone Group's ICA B.V. subsidiary provides international long distance services in The Netherlands.

Logiphone Group has negotiated a strategic alliance agreement with Logiphone Israel to purchase the Logiphone PBX on a most favored customer basis and at a discounted price. The agreement contemplates that Logiphone Group will loan Logiphone Israel $1 million for research and development.

The company also has negotiated an agreement to sell 500,000 shares of Logiphone Group to an affiliate of Logiphone Israel. In addition, ICA B.V. entered into a strategic alliance with RADLINX Ltd in Tel Aviv, Israel, through which Logiphone Group plans to establish an international "Fax Over Internet" service network.
Logiphone owns three telecommunications switches in The Netherlands.
